Apologies for the extra work — can you confirm next steps and expected timeline?

Thanks Aditya — I reviewed the CSV. Action plan below (I also attached a journal template):

1) Identify unapplied credit batch: AR_UNAPPL_20270222 (balance €62,450)
2) Create posting to allocate funds to invoices:
   - Debit AR_UNAPPL_20270222 €62,450
   - Credit Accounts Receivable — Customer: Acme Telecom — INV-55678 €41,300
   - Credit Accounts Receivable — Customer: Acme Telecom — INV-55679 €21,150
3) Tax treatment: INV-55678 -> standard EU VAT (apply 20% VAT on the invoice line where applicable); INV-55679 -> zero-rated export (supporting docs required from customer for zero rating)
4) Create a correcting journal (GL journal JRN-2027-045) moving the unapplied bucket to AR and documenting the customer reference and remittance file id.

Revenue recognition notes: allocating payments does not change recognized revenue if invoices were already recognized on delivery. However, if either invoice had been deferred and recognized across periods, we will need to run a short RR reclassification. Per Marcus — please advise if either INV-55678 or INV-55679 has been mapped to deferred revenue Sched-DR-02.

I will prepare the journal entries and send for approval. Please confirm if we should proceed with the VAT split now or wait for Acme to supply export documentation.

Attachments: journal_template.xlsx (xlsx)

-N
Naomi Feldman
Senior Finance Manager — Billing & AR
Redwood Inference

Couple quick points from a revenue/aging perspective:

- Aging: once Naomi posts the allocations, AR balances will move out of the unapplied bucket into current/past due based on invoice dates. That will change the AR aging buckets for the customer and improve DSO measurables for Sales.
- Revenue recognition mapping: I checked our ledger mapping — INV-55678 is recognized at invoice (no deferral); INV-55679 is mapped to deferred schedule Sched-DR-02 (small multi-month professional services component). Because INV-55679 is only partially paid, we need to ensure the payment allocation does not prematurely pull forward any recognition. Recommended approach: post the allocation to the invoice but do NOT run a recognition reversal; instead, tag the journal with memo: "payment allocation only — no RR change". Run a reconciliation job in the March close to confirm recognition remains unchanged.

Also confirm deal id ACM-2026-311 is the correct reference so I can link the journal to the right revenue contract in the ledger. I'll log a quick note in HubSpot: https://hubspot.company/contacts/ACM-2026-311

Marcus Lin
Finance — Revenue Operations
